summary.intent: Assess and plan Phase 72 (SDK write-plane durability/correctness), audit stale/pending todos across Phases 70-71 for drift, then run the full plan→execute→ship GSD loop for Phase 72 — which was interrupted by two urgent CI regressions (desktop-e2e and web-e2e) that had to be diagnosed and fixed first.
summary.outcome: Retired 8 stale Phase 71 todos and folded 2 new todos into Phase 72/73 scope; fixed three CI regressions (FUSE seq-1 equivocation, stale rotation-durability IDB store test, sdk-e2e Test 21 flake) merged via PR #601 and #600; then fully planned, executed (10 plans across 7 waves), hardened (fixed 113 pre-existing test-file TS errors, wired CI to typecheck tests, found and fixed a DoS-class cycle-guard bug), and shipped Phase 72 as PR #602 — including a HIGH-severity security finding (moveItem write-chain resurrection) found and fixed pre-merge; PR CI green, awaiting final review-thread resolution and merge.

repo: cipher-box GSD repo closes todos by deleting pending/ files and moving to completed/ — if a phase ships without doing this, its source todos silently linger in pending/ (drift source)

ci-e2e.yml (Web E2E + Desktop E2E) triggers ONLY on push-to-main or workflow_dispatch, never on PRs — must dispatch manually via `gh workflow run <file> --ref <branch>` (not `-f ref=`, which 422s on older workflow definitions) to validate before merge

Phase 70.1 collapsed IndexedDB stores `generation-high-water`+`seq-high-water` into a single `rotation-floor` store (DB `cipherbox-rotation-state` v2, keyed by nodeId) — old store names are gone, stale test helpers referencing them silently return undefined

Playwright web-e2e: `ciFloor()` helper raises wait timeouts to a 60s floor only under CI (process.env.CI) — bare local timeouts (15s/30s) are systematically tighter than what CI actually runs, causing local-only flakes that don't represent real CI risk; CI=1 locally also flips `webServer.reuseExistingServer` to false, fighting an already-running dev stack
vitest does not load .env — sdk-e2e test harness reads `process.env.SDK_E2E_SECRET` with a fallback dummy value if not exported, causing silent 401s even when the API's own .env matches

Cross-package types in this monorepo resolve via workspace symlinks to each package's built `dist` (no path aliases/project references), so test-inclusive typecheck must run per-package after that package's build, not all up-front

packages/sdk test suite had drifted onto retired Phase-62 types (FileMetadata, FolderChild, FolderEntry, FolderMetadata, VaultInit.rootFolderKey) — CI's `pnpm typecheck` only ran tsconfig.build.json (excludes tests) so this went undetected until an explicit test-inclusive tsc pass

`dfsFindFolder` in client.ts uses a `visited: Set<string>` cycle guard; `collectDescendantIpnsNames` lacked the analogous guard — unbounded recursion on a cyclic/malicious folder graph (DoS-class), now fixed

base-aware CAS-merge (registration.ts `updateFolderMetadataAndPublish` baseWriteChildren param) must be threaded through every write-chain-mutating operation (deleteItem, restoreFromBin, permanentDeleteFromBin, moveItem) — omitting it on any one operation reopens the exact resurrection vulnerability the others were fixed for

stale desktop-e2e `.mts` test drivers can silently reference pre-rename DTO fields (Phase 71 renamed readDescriptorRef→encryptedReadKey, rootIpnsName→shareRootIpnsName) causing ValidationPipe 400s unrelated to the code under test

code.finding: moveItem's SOURCE-folder publish dropped the moved child's WriteChildRef but never passed baseWriteChildren to updateFolderMetadataAndPublish, unlike deleteItem/restoreFromBin — allowing a concurrent stale republish to resurrect write access to a moved item via its old parent folder. Fixed by capturing sourceBaseWriteChildren before the filter and threading it through (commits dd8264a06/65024c3ce).

publish_file_node hardcoded seq=1 on first-publish branch gated only on 'inode cid empty', so a dropped/stale UploadComplete re-run re-sealed at seq=1 with a new CID, tripping Phase 71's anti-equivocation gate. Fixed by resolving IPNS before first-publish and routing Found outcomes into the existing CAS-retry path.

Base-aware write-body merge: when baseWriteChildren is undefined, falls back to a naive union where remote entries always win — this is what resurrects dropped WriteChildRefs; passing baseWriteChildren enables correct pruning.

collectDescendantIpnsNames added a visited Set shared by reference across recursive calls, marked before any await, mirroring dfsFindFolder's cycle-termination pattern — closes an unbounded-recursion DoS on cyclic folder graphs.

workflow: When a subagent's tool output disagrees with a direct check (e.g. git cat-file vs git status), re-verify decisively rather than trusting either blindly — the earlier check itself may be buggy

For long unattended autonomous runs, capture non-obvious scope decisions (e.g. 'fix all TS drift + wire CI' spanning many waves) as a durable todo file immediately so they survive context compaction, then also track via TaskCreate

When dispatching a CI workflow to validate a PR before merge, ensure the branch actually includes all prerequisite fixes (rebase first) — dispatching against a stale head wastes a full CI cycle and produces misleading failures

Local flake reproduction can chase a moving target (each run fails a different, ambient-latency-sensitive test) — the reliable fix is to reproduce under the exact CI timeout regime (patch webServer.reuseExistingServer temporarily, run with CI=1) rather than repeatedly re-running the default local regime

Distinguish 'test/fixture drift from a renamed API' from 'real product regression' early by checking whether the failure signature changed between the pre-fix and post-fix runs, and whether the same bug class appears identically across OSes (strong signal of a real bug vs. environment noise)

Security/code-review agents examining the same files can validate each other — corroboration (or lack of it) between an independent security reviewer and CodeRabbit CLI is useful evidence for triaging severity of overlapping findings

friction: Hooks JSON for gsd-core plan:pre fragments contains raw/literal control characters in string values, breaking `jq`/direct JSON.parse — required writing a custom lenient parser script twice
`gh workflow run -f ref=...` returns HTTP 422 on this repo's older workflow definition; had to discover `--ref <branch>` as the working alternative
API server on :3000 repeatedly served stale TEST_LOGIN_SECRET from an old dist build after edits — required killing and restarting from source each time, a recurring manual step
sdk-e2e 401s were caused by vitest not loading .env, requiring secrets to be manually exported into the shell before each run — non-obvious and cost two full wasted live-test runs to diagnose

Local web-e2e verification cascaded through multiple ambient/cold-stack timeout flakes (4.10, 4.11, then 2.1) across 7 sequential background runs before reliably reaching the actual target tests (6.6.2, 8.2), consuming significant wall-clock time

`git commit` via the commit helper reported a 2-minute timeout (likely 1Password SSH-signing prompt hanging) despite the commit actually landing — required manual verification via git log rather than trusting the tool's own status
lint-staged/commit hook timeout ambiguity happened more than once across the session, always requiring a manual git log check to confirm true state

CodeRabbit CLI found 10 major + 9 minor findings requiring careful triage against a parallel independent security review to avoid duplicate/conflicting fixes on the same file (client.ts) at the same time
